name: junk-drawer
description: Where useful agent skills end up. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and most other agent harnesses.

skills.name: crossfire
skills.summary: Turns an idea or draft into a design and plan that holds up: finds the agent CLIs you have (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Qwen, OpenCode, Pi), runs adversarial reviews from different models in turn, revises after each, and hands you the decisions that are yours.

skills.name: docsmith
skills.summary: Reviews or builds decks, spreadsheets, documents, Markdown, and wiki pages: structure, layout, accessibility, editability, formulas, and charts. Follows your DESIGN.md, brand, or template. Fixes the small things, flags the big ones.

skills.name: night-shift
skills.summary: Maintains repository architecture through recurring audits and improvements, or reviews a supplied target. Agent tasks have explicit contracts; findings cover business logic and UI boundaries, shared rules and constants, defects, tooling gaps, and hot paths. Carries evidence and unfinished work between runs.

skills.name: project-backup
skills.summary: Backs up what Git cannot give back: signing keys, credentials, private config, and local data. Builds a dated, owner-only folder with restore notes and checksums, to keep wherever you like or carry to a new laptop.

skills.name: unslop
skills.summary: Makes a draft read like a person wrote it: strips chat residue, checks facts and story, cuts the patterns that mark text as machine-written, keeps the writer's voice.
